news.text: #SPALLETTI UNDER FIREThe social media backlashDisappointing start: #Carnevali defends Lucio, but #Conte is the hot topicAlready at -5 from the top: #NEC and #Atalanta are two crucial tests#Juve penalized by the injuries to #Yildiz, #Thuram and #Locatelli. #Kolo still lagging behind. Anticipation for #Woltemade. Tomorrow is the Europa League debut: #McKennie and #Cambiaso are back with the group. [Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

"#JUVE, THINK POSITIVE"Campagna, coach of the water polo national team and a huge bianconero fan"The moment is difficult, but you don't get out of it with the negativity: I can't even stand the pessimistic and constantly complaining fans anymore. #Spalletti needs to become... a player again and be with his players in a different way, highlighting the good things and transmitting energy: he needs to choose the leaders"The first good news: #McKennie available for the Europa LeagueTomorrow against #NEC: #Grabara in goal?[Front Page TuttoSport]

In Beppe’s mind:I never cared too much about formations 442, 352, 3421 or whatever. As long as it’s a bit balanced and adapted to the players at disposal it’s all good to me. I believe more in on the pitch behaviour than total football revolutions. However what worries me is when you change formations to be more protected, suffer less and block opponents strategies. One shot is an acceptable exception. Not as a medium or long term solution.
Amaiur Sarriegi is a new Juventus Women player ✍️Welcome, Amaiur! 🤍🖤[Juventus]

GJustjuve 😒⁉️ #Spalletti remains firm on the #Juventus bench, but trust is not infinite. The club demands a quick turnaround: after just four matchdays, it is not acceptable to resign themselves to a catch-up championship. [Gazzetta dello Sport via @Juventus_Reborn] https://t.me/GJustjuve/73079🧠🆙 The #Sassuolo match took away all free passes: the version seen on Sunday must never exist again. Injuries play a part, but they cannot be an alibi for a performance like this. #Spalletti takes the blame, but he is asking the group to find again enthusiasm, courage and the willingness to take risks. The club expects the same from the manager, the confusion must be quickly erased.[Gazzetta dello Spor

🔙✅ #McKennie and #Cambiaso are putting forward their respective cases to return to the squad list against #NEC. The American is feeling much better: his muscle fatigue has passed and the staff is only evaluating the risk of a relapse. On the other hand, the Italian has put his ankle discomfort behind him and is awaiting the green light from the medical staff. #Alajbegovic, who went off against #Sassuolo due to a feeling of exhaustion, does not need any medical tests and will be available.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🆙❗️Yesterday, #Spalletti spoke to the team in front of the top executives, demanding a deep awakening regarding their attitude and reading of the game against #Sassuolo. The coach chose a soft approach, avoiding a trial-like tone. The main problem that emerged is tactical: deploying three attacking midfielders simultaneously without #McKennie left the midfield unprotected, exposing the backline to opposition transitions.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]
